instruction: The first phone's Simple SMS Messenger received a one-time code, and the second phone's Markor note `Account note` has the account id. Please enter the account id and code in `/home/user/account/verify.html` in Linux Chrome to complete the two-step verification.
surfaces: android_0 Simple SMS Messenger + android_1 Markor -> Chrome form
fixture_notes: The account id and one-time code come from different agent-visible phones.
The host receipt is run-scoped and requires exact trimmed ACC-28491 and 4829 values.
